description: Tender chicken breast pieces simmered in a spiced tomato and onion curry sauce, a lean and flavourful Kenyan meal.

steps.instruction: Cut chicken breast into chunks and season with salt. Heat oil and brown the chicken for 4–5 minutes, then remove.
Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Add curry powder and chopped tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Return chicken to the pan, add water and simmer for 15 minutes until cooked through. Serve hot with rice or chapati.

description: Chicken breast marinated with lemon and garlic, then grilled until juicy and golden, a healthy Kenyan option.

steps.instruction: Mix lemon juice, crushed garlic, oil, salt and black pepper into a marinade. Coat chicken breast and rest for 15 minutes.
Heat a grill pan or barbecue. Grill chicken for 6–7 minutes per side until cooked through and charred.
Rest for 5 minutes, slice and serve with kachumbari or salad.

description: Chicken breast simmered in a rich tomato and onion gravy, a simple Kenyan comfort dish.

steps.instruction: Cut chicken breast into cubes. Heat oil and brown chicken for 4 minutes, then remove.
Sauté onion and garlic until golden. Add tomatoes and cook until they form a sauce.
Return chicken, add salt and water, and simmer for 15 minutes. Serve hot with ugali or rice.

description: Fragrant pilau rice cooked with chicken breast, pilau masala and caramelised onions.

steps.instruction: Fry onions until deep golden. Add chicken breast cubes and brown.
Stir in pilau masala and rice. Add water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until rice is tender. Fluff and serve with kachumbari.

description: Chicken breast simmered in a creamy coconut curry with tomatoes and mild spices.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken breast chunks in oil for 4 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onion until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add coconut milk and return chicken. Simmer for 15 minutes. Season and serve with rice.

description: Juicy chicken thighs slow-cooked in a savory tomato and onion stew, a Kenyan family favourite.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken thighs in hot oil for 6–8 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onions and garlic until golden. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Return chicken, add salt and water, cover and simmer for 25 minutes until tender. Serve hot.

description: Chicken thighs cooked in a rich, spiced curry sauce with onions and tomatoes.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken thighs in oil for 6–8 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onions and garlic until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes and cook until thick.
Return chicken, add water and salt, simmer for 20 minutes until cooked. Serve with rice.

description: Aromatic pilau rice cooked with chicken thighs, pilau masala and onions.

steps.instruction: Fry onions until golden. Add chicken thighs and brown.
Add pilau masala and rice, stir to coat. Add water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20–25 minutes until rice and chicken are cooked. Serve.

description: Chicken thighs marinated with garlic and lemon, grilled until charred and juicy.

steps.instruction: Mix lemon juice, garlic, oil, salt and pepper. Marinate chicken thighs for 15 minutes.
Grill over medium heat for 10 minutes per side until cooked through and charred.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with kachumbari.

description: Chicken thighs simmered in a creamy coconut curry with tomatoes and spices.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken thighs in oil for 5 minutes. Remove.
Sauté onion until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Add coconut milk and chicken, simmer for 20 minutes. Season and serve with rice.

description: Chicken drumsticks simmered in a rich tomato and onion stew, a comforting Kenyan meal.

steps.instruction: Brown drumsticks in oil for 6–8 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onions and garlic until golden. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Return chicken, add salt and water, simmer for 25 minutes until tender. Serve.

description: Chicken drumsticks cooked in a spiced curry sauce with onions and tomatoes.

steps.instruction: Brown drumsticks in oil for 6–8 minutes. Remove.
Sauté onions and garlic until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes and cook until thick.
Return chicken, add water and salt, simmer for 20 minutes. Serve with rice.

description: Fragrant pilau rice cooked with chicken drumsticks, pilau masala and onions.

steps.instruction: Fry onions until golden. Add drumsticks and brown.
Add pilau masala and rice, stir. Add water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20–25 minutes until cooked. Serve.

description: Chicken drumsticks marinated with garlic and lemon, grilled until charred and juicy.

steps.instruction: Mix lemon juice, garlic, oil, salt and pepper. Marinate drumsticks for 15 minutes.
Grill over medium heat for 10 minutes per side until cooked and charred.
Rest and serve with kachumbari.

description: Chicken drumsticks simmered in a creamy coconut curry with tomatoes and spices.

steps.instruction: Brown drumsticks in oil for 5 minutes. Remove.
Sauté onion until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Add coconut milk and chicken, simmer for 20 minutes. Season and serve with rice.

description: A whole chicken roasted with garlic, lemon and spices until golden and juicy.

steps.instruction: Rub the chicken with lemon juice, crushed garlic, paprika, oil, salt and pepper.
Roast in a preheated oven at 200°C for 50–60 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Rest for 10 minutes, carve and serve with kachumbari.

description: A whole chicken cut into pieces and simmered in a rich tomato and onion stew.

steps.instruction: Cut chicken into pieces and brown in oil for 8–10 minutes. Remove.
Sauté onions and garlic until golden. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Return chicken, add salt and water, simmer for 30 minutes until tender. Serve.

description: A whole chicken cut into pieces and cooked in a spiced curry sauce.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken pieces in oil for 8–10 minutes. Remove.
Sauté onions and garlic until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes, cook until thick.
Return chicken, add water and salt, simmer for 30 minutes. Serve with rice.

description: A celebratory pilau made with a whole chicken cut into pieces, rice and pilau masala.

steps.instruction: Fry onions until deep golden. Add chicken pieces and brown.
Stir in pilau masala and rice. Add water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 25–30 minutes until rice and chicken are cooked. Serve.

description: A whole chicken cut into pieces and simmered in a creamy coconut curry.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken pieces in oil for 8 minutes. Remove.
Sauté onions until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Add coconut milk and chicken, simmer for 30 minutes. Season and serve with rice.

description: Chicken pieces cooked with garam masala, onions and tomatoes, a Kenyan-Indian fusion favourite.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in oil for 6–8 minutes. Remove.
Sauté onions and garlic until golden. Add tomatoes and garam masala, cook until saucy.
Return chicken, add water and salt, simmer for 20 minutes. Serve hot.

name_sw: Nyama ya Ng'ombe ya Garam Masala
description: Beef cubes simmered in a rich tomato sauce flavoured with garam masala.

steps.instruction: Boil beef until tender, about 30 minutes. Reserve broth.
Sauté onions and garlic until golden. Add tomatoes and garam masala, cook until saucy.
Add beef and broth, simmer for 15 minutes. Season and serve.

description: Fragrant rice cooked with garam masala, onions and a touch of turmeric.

steps.instruction: Rinse rice. Sauté onion in oil until soft.
Stir in garam masala and rice. Add water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until tender. Fluff and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with chicken or beef stew.

description: Potatoes roasted or fried with garam masala, onions and tomatoes, a spicy Kenyan side.

steps.instruction: Peel and cube potatoes. Boil for 10 minutes, then drain.
Sauté onion in oil until golden. Add tomatoes and garam masala.
Add potatoes and salt, stir-fry for 8–10 minutes until coated and crisp. Serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve as a side with grilled meat.

description: Tilapia fillets pan-fried with garam masala and served in a tomato sauce.

steps.instruction: Rub fish with garam masala and salt. Fry in oil for 3 minutes per side. Remove.
Sauté onion until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Return fish to pan and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve with rice.

description: Chicken pieces cooked with fresh lemongrass, garlic and ginger, a fragrant Kenyan dish.

steps.instruction: Bruise lemongrass stalks and chop finely. Brown chicken in oil for 6–8 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, ginger and lemongrass, cook for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add water and salt, cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve hot.

description: Tilapia simmered with lemongrass, tomatoes and onions, a fragrant coastal Kenyan fish dish.

steps.instruction: Clean and score tilapia. Fry in oil for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove.
Sauté onion and chopped lemongrass until soft. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add water, return fish and simmer for 8–10 minutes. Season and serve.

description: Fragrant rice cooked with lemongrass stalks, onions and a pinch of salt.

steps.instruction: Bruise lemongrass and tie in a bundle. Sauté onion in oil until soft.
Add rice, water, salt and lemongrass bundle. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove lemongrass, fluff and serve.

description: A soothing Kenyan tea made by steeping fresh lemongrass with tea leaves and milk.

steps.instruction: Bruise lemongrass and boil in water for 3 minutes.
Add tea leaves and milk, simmer for 4 minutes.
Strain, sweeten if desired and serve hot.

description: Beef strips stir-fried with lemongrass, garlic and ginger, a fragrant Kenyan dish.

steps.instruction: Slice beef thinly. Chop lemongrass finely.
Heat oil and stir-fry beef for 3–4 minutes until browned. Add onion, garlic and lemongrass.
Cook for 5 minutes, season with salt and serve with rice.

description: Chicken pieces cooked with mchuzi mix, onions and tomatoes, a rich Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in oil for 6–8 minutes. Remove.
Sauté onions until golden. Add tomatoes and mchuzi mix, cook until saucy.
Return chicken, add water and salt, simmer for 20 minutes. Serve.

name_sw: Nyama ya Ng'ombe ya Mchuzi Mix
description: Beef cubes simmered in a rich tomato gravy seasoned with mchuzi mix.

steps.instruction: Boil beef until tender, about 30 minutes. Reserve broth.
Sauté onions until golden. Add tomatoes and mchuzi mix, cook until saucy.
Add beef and broth, simmer for 15 minutes. Serve with ugali.

description: Tilapia cooked in a tomato sauce seasoned with mchuzi mix, a quick Kenyan fish stew.

steps.instruction: Fry tilapia in oil for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove.
Sauté onion until soft. Add tomatoes and mchuzi mix, cook until saucy.
Add water, return fish and simmer for 8 minutes. Serve.

description: Beans simmered in a tomato sauce seasoned with mchuzi mix, a flavourful Kenyan vegetarian stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until golden. Add tomatoes and mchuzi mix, cook until saucy.
Add beans and salt. Stir well.
Simmer for 10–15 minutes. Serve with rice or chapati.

description: Rice cooked with mchuzi mix and vegetables, a quick and savoury Kenyan one-pot rice.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and diced carrot in oil until soft. Stir in mchuzi mix.
Add rice and stir to coat. Add water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until tender. Fluff and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with a side of greens.

description: Chicken pieces stir-fried with plenty of coarsely ground black pepper, onions and a savoury sauce.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in oil for 6–8 minutes. Add onions and cook until soft.
Add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Stir in black pepper and salt.
Add water and simmer for 15 minutes. Serve with rice or chapati.

name_sw: Nyama ya Ng'ombe ya Pilipili Manga
description: Beef strips stir-fried with black pepper, onions and tomatoes, a peppery Kenyan dish.

steps.instruction: Slice beef thinly. Heat oil and stir-fry beef for 3–4 minutes.
Add onion and cook until soft. Add tomatoes if using and cook until saucy.
Stir in black pepper and salt, cook for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

description: Tilapia fillets pan-fried and finished with a black pepper and lemon sauce.

steps.instruction: Season fish with salt and half the black pepper. Fry in oil for 3 minutes per side.
Remove fish. Sauté onion in the same pan, add lemon juice and remaining pepper.
Pour sauce over fish and serve with rice.

description: Rice cooked with black pepper, onions and a little butter for a simple peppery side.

steps.instruction: Rinse rice. Sauté onion in butter (or oil) until soft.
Add rice, black pepper, salt and water. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Fluff and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with grilled meat or fish.

description: Crispy fried potatoes tossed with black pepper and salt, a simple Kenyan snack or side.

steps.instruction: Cut potatoes into wedges or chips. Heat oil in a deep pan.
Fry potatoes in batches until golden and crisp. Drain.
Toss with black pepper and salt. Serve hot.

serving_suggestion: Serve as a snack with kachumbari.

description: Amaranth leaves cooked with onions and tomatoes into a simple Kenyan green stew.

steps.instruction: Wash and chop amaranth leaves. Sauté onion in oil until golden.
Add tomatoes and cook until softened.
Add amaranth leaves and salt, stir-fry for 5–7 minutes. Serve hot.

description: Amaranth leaves sautéed with onions and scrambled eggs, a nutritious Kenyan breakfast or light meal.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in oil until soft. Add chopped amaranth leaves and cook for 3 minutes.
Beat eggs with salt and pour over the greens.
Scramble until eggs are set. Serve with chapati or bread.

description: Amaranth leaves simmered with beans in a tomato-onion sauce, a protein-rich Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until golden. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add beans and cook for 5 minutes.
Add amaranth leaves and salt, cook for 5 minutes until wilted. Serve.

description: Amaranth leaves sautéed with onions and tomatoes, served alongside hot ugali.

steps.instruction: Boil water and salt, gradually add maize flour and stir until firm. Shape ugali.
Sauté onion in oil until golden. Add amaranth leaves and cook for 5–7 minutes.
Serve the amaranth leaves with the hot ugali.

description: Amaranth leaves simmered in creamy coconut milk with onions and mild spices.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in oil until soft. Add amaranth leaves and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and add salt.
Simmer for 5–7 minutes until greens are tender. Serve with rice.

description: Simple boiled arrowroot pieces, a traditional Kenyan side or snack with an earthy flavour.

steps.instruction: Peel arrowroot and cut into chunks. Wash well.
Boil in salted water for 20–25 minutes until tender.
Drain and serve hot as a snack or side.

description: Arrowroot chunks simmered in a tomato and onion stew, a hearty Kenyan vegetarian dish.

steps.instruction: Peel and cube arrowroot. Sauté onion in oil until golden.
Add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Add arrowroot, salt and water.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until arrowroot is tender. Serve.

description: Crispy fried arrowroot strips, a Kenyan snack similar to potato chips but firmer.

steps.instruction: Peel arrowroot and cut into thin strips.
Heat oil and fry in batches until golden and crisp.
Drain, sprinkle with salt and serve hot.

serving_suggestion: Serve as a snack with kachumbari.

description: A comforting Kenyan soup made with arrowroot, onions, tomatoes and garlic.

steps.instruction: Peel and cube arrowroot. Sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add tomatoes and cook until softened. Add arrowroot and water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until arrowroot is tender. Season and serve.

description: Arrowroot and beans simmered together in a tomato-onion sauce, a filling Kenyan meal.

steps.instruction: Peel and cube arrowroot. Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add arrowroot, beans, salt and water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until arrowroot is tender. Serve hot.
